//: CODE-002: an Invariant for every repository.
text: Never pass a check by weakening it (deleting, skipping or loosening tests, suppressing errors, special-casing inputs); if a test or the task seems wrong, stop and say so.
why: Agents game impossible tests, and an explicit way to stop nearly eliminates it.
to_add: a CI check that flags deleted or skipped tests, lowered thresholds and edited snapshots
counting executed tests from JUnit output instead of trusting the exit status
